note: Fictional internal wiki pages (dummy). The Space shows them, and the connector tool read_wiki_page returns the same text to the agent. The SOPs of the Infrastructure Operations Space point to these pages and steps.

pages.title: Renew a TLS certificate
pages.purpose: Replace a server certificate before it expires, without an outage and with evidence. Valid for TLS certificates of customer systems that Infrastructure Operations runs.
pages.scope: In scope: server and gateway certificates in the inventory. Out of scope: client certificates, root certificates, certificates of SaaS tenants.

roles.who: Operations: opens or accepts the change
AWX job template, started by n8n

before: The certificate and its VMs are in the inventory.
No freeze period covers the window.
The window is at most 8 hours long.

steps.title: Detect the expiry
steps.summary: n8n lists every certificate that expires within 30 days and starts one change per certificate.
do: Daily at 06:00 n8n reads Not After of all certificates in the inventory.
A certificate with 30 days or less left starts a change; one with 7 days or less is marked urgent.
steps.doneWhen: A change exists for the certificate.
steps.onFailure: Alert the on-call engineer if the list cannot be read.

steps.title: Open the change ticket
steps.summary: Every change has a ticket with owner, customer and target.
do: n8n creates the ticket in the ITSM and the task in the Space.
The ticket names customer, certificate, affected VMs and the planned window.
steps.doneWhen: Ticket number is on the task.
steps.onFailure: Create the ticket by hand and enter the number on the task.

steps.title: Generate key pair and CSR
steps.summary: Create a new key pair on the target and a signing request; the private key never leaves the server.
do: Run the playbook in check mode, then for real before the window.
The CSR carries the common name and all names of the certificate from the DNS inventory.
steps.doneWhen: A CSR file exists on the target; the key file does not leave it.
steps.onFailure: Stop. Do not copy a private key to another system under any circumstance.

steps.title: Check chain and names
steps.summary: Check mode: issuer and chain complete, all names covered, no conflict in the change calendar.
do: Check that the intermediate certificates of the issuer are available.
Compare the names in the CSR with the DNS records of the VMs.
Look for overlapping changes of the same customer.
steps.doneWhen: All pre-checks are green or have a written note.
steps.onFailure: Fix the finding or move the window; do not submit with a failed check.

steps.title: Approve (four eyes)
steps.summary: Production needs two approvals from different roles; the requester cannot approve.
do: n8n asks the approvers in Teams and shows the pre-check result.
Approver 1 is Security, approver 2 the Change manager.
steps.doneWhen: Two approvals are recorded.
steps.onFailure: A rejection closes the change with the reason on the ticket.

steps.title: Wait for the downtime window
steps.summary: Start only inside the approved window.
do: n8n waits until the window opens.
The run never starts earlier, even if everything is approved.
steps.doneWhen: The window is open.
steps.onFailure: If the window passes, the change returns to planned.

steps.title: Enrol with the CA over a secure protocol
steps.summary: Send the CSR to the certificate authority by ACME or EST, never by e-mail.
do: The playbook submits the CSR through the enrolment endpoint of the CA.
It waits until the signed certificate is returned.
steps.doneWhen: A signed certificate and the chain are on the target.
steps.onFailure: Retry once; then stop and ask Security.

steps.title: Install certificate and chain
steps.summary: Install the new certificate with its intermediate certificates and reload the services.
do: Keep the old certificate files until verification is done.
Reload the services; no restart is needed.
steps.doneWhen: The services present the new certificate.
steps.onFailure: Put the old certificate back and reload.

steps.title: Verify the new certificate
steps.summary: Check Not After, chain and a TLS handshake on every name.
do: The new Not After is at least 300 days away.
The chain validates and the handshake works on every name.
steps.doneWhen: All checks pass.
steps.onFailure: Roll back to the old certificate and mark the change failed.

steps.title: Evidence and old certificate
steps.summary: File the log, close the ticket, inform the customer; revoke the old certificate if its key may be compromised.
do: Attach the log, the old and the new Not After to the ticket.
Revoke the old certificate only if its key may have been exposed.
steps.doneWhen: Ticket is closed with evidence.
steps.onFailure: Keep the ticket open until the evidence is complete.

pages.rollback: Reinstall the old certificate files and reload the services. Revoke nothing in a rollback.

pages.title: Patch and restart a VM
pages.purpose: Install open security patches on one VM in a maintenance window, with a backup, a test on the twin system and a way back.
pages.scope: In scope: Linux VMs in the inventory (SAP application, database and web dispatcher hosts). Out of scope: kernel live patching, firmware, appliances.

roles.who: Operations: opens or accepts the change
AWX job template, started by n8n

before: The VM and its dependent systems are in the inventory.
There is a backup from the last 24 hours (the pre-check blocks the change otherwise).
No freeze period covers the window.

steps.title: Decide what to patch and when
steps.summary: Decide which patches go to which systems at what time; critical patches start a change.
do: The finding "critical patches open" or the monthly schedule starts the change.
Group VMs of one customer into one window where they depend on each other.
steps.doneWhen: A change exists for the VM.
steps.onFailure: Ask the change manager if the patch level is unclear.

steps.title: Open the change ticket
steps.summary: Every change has a ticket with owner, customer and target.
do: n8n creates the ticket in the ITSM and the task in the Space.
The ticket lists the dependent systems that stop during the restart.
steps.doneWhen: Ticket number is on the task.
steps.onFailure: Create the ticket by hand and enter the number on the task.

steps.title: Confirm the patches fit this VM
steps.summary: Check mode: operating system, open patches and critical patches of this VM.
do: Compare the OS release with the patch list.
Note how many patches are critical.
steps.doneWhen: Patch list matches the OS release.
steps.onFailure: Remove the patch that does not fit and note it on the ticket.

steps.title: Backup first, rollback ready
steps.summary: No backup from the last 24 hours, no run; a snapshot is taken right before patching.
do: The pre-check reads the age of the last backup.
The playbook takes a snapshot immediately before the window work.
steps.doneWhen: Backup is younger than 24 hours.
steps.onFailure: Take a new backup, then run the pre-check again.

steps.title: Patch the non-production twin first
steps.summary: Patch the QAS system of the same customer first and run its health check.
do: Run the same patch list on the QAS twin.
Run the health check and compare it with the state before.
steps.doneWhen: The twin is healthy with the new patches.
steps.onFailure: Stop. Do not schedule production until the twin is healthy.

steps.title: Approve (four eyes)
steps.summary: Production needs two approvals from different roles; the requester cannot approve.
do: n8n asks the approvers in Teams and shows pre-check and twin result.
Approver 1 is the Change manager.
steps.doneWhen: Two approvals are recorded.
steps.onFailure: A rejection closes the change with the reason on the ticket.

steps.title: Wait for the downtime window
steps.summary: Start only inside the approved window; dependent systems stop while the VM restarts.
do: Inform the customer about the stop of the dependent systems.
n8n waits until the window opens.
steps.doneWhen: The window is open and the customer is informed.
steps.onFailure: If the window passes, the change returns to planned.

steps.title: Apply the patches and restart
steps.summary: Install the patches persistently, restart the VM and wait for its dependent systems.
do: The playbook installs the patch list and restarts the VM.
It waits until the dependent systems are up again.
steps.doneWhen: The VM is up with no pending patches.
steps.onFailure: Restore the snapshot.

steps.title: Verify, roll back on failure
steps.summary: Run the health checks; if one fails, restore the snapshot.
do: Check services, ports and the patch level.
Compare with the state before the change.
steps.doneWhen: All checks pass.
steps.onFailure: Restore the snapshot and mark the change failed.

steps.title: Evidence and patch level
steps.summary: File the log, update the patch level of the VM, close the ticket, inform customer and team.
do: Attach the log and the patch list to the ticket.
Update the patch level in the inventory.
steps.doneWhen: Ticket is closed with evidence.
steps.onFailure: Keep the ticket open until the evidence is complete.

pages.rollback: Restore the snapshot taken before the patch, start the VM and check its dependent systems.
evidence: Ticket with log and patch list
